content:
Maria Chen: Heads-up — running a 6h mixed k6+Locust soak in prod-mirror (replay dataset v2) after PR #3421 merged. At ~2h we saw a p95 latency spike on /v1/generate and a tokenization CPU jump on gpu1. Can someone triage? I'm collecting flamegraphs and k6/locust logs.

Alex Rivera: On it. Do you have the k6 script + locustfile and the exact model variant used? Also, any recent changes to tokenizer in that PR?

Maria Chen: k6 script is `k6-replay-v2.js`, locust file `replay_locustfile.py`. Model pinned to `redwood-medium-quantized-v1`. PR #3421 touched tokenizer (split_token loop optimization). k6 ramp snippet: ```js
export let options = {vus: 400, duration: '6h'}
export default function () { http.batch([['GET','/replay/1']]) }
```

Sami Patel: tagging eng-runtime — please check KV cache hit rate and batching metrics. Historically p95 tokenization spikes line up with `metrics.kv_hits` drops. I see a drop around 1958764120 in Grafana.

Priya Nair: I pulled a quick flamegraph from pod gpu1:tokenizer -> tokenization stage shows ~45% CPU increase vs baseline. The hotspot is in the split_token loop introduced in PR #3421. Attaching a small excerpt: `for (i=0; i<len; ++i) { if (is_sep) ... }` — looks like an extra bounds check per char.

Alex Rivera: If that matches, we should canary-revert the tokenizer change and rerun the soak. @ci-bot can you start a canary rollback to previous image on the soak cluster (keep logs)? :thinking_face:

ci-bot: Deploy job queued -> starting job 9876 for image `redwood/runtime:2026-03-16-stable` to cluster `soak-prod-mirror`. See https://ci.redwood.internal/jobs/9876

Maria Chen: Thanks. I'll keep the soak running and leave tracing enabled for another 30m. If canary reduces p95 I'll open a rollback PR and block the next batch deploy.

Sami Patel: Quick request — can someone upload the raw k6 artifact (logs.tar.gz) from this run to `/artifacts/soak/1958765432` so I can replay locally and verify the tokenizer path?

Priya Nair: Uploading now (logs.tar.gz -> /artifacts/soak/1958765432). Also added the flamegraph SVG. :white_check_mark:

Alex Rivera: Great. After canary finishes I'll compare traces and post a brief root-cause note here. If anyone else wants to run a targeted locust profile against gpu1:tokenizer napi endpoint, ping me and I'll hand off credentials. :eyes:

Maria Chen: Appreciate the quick responses. Keeping this thread open for final perf diff and next steps.
